newsitem.title: USA: America West Airlines cuts fares.
newsitem.headline: America West Airlines cuts fares.

text.p: America West Airlines said late on Monday that it would begin a fare sale effective immediately for travel from March 17 to November 4.
The carrier said fares would begin as low as $59 each way from Phoenix to Orange County, California, and as low as $134 each way from Miami or Atlanta to Las Vegas or Phoenix.
Tickets must be bought no later than March 25, the carrier said.
America West Airlines is a wholly owned subsidiary of America West Holdings Corp.
